meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手切换到高强度工作模式,长时间专注推进复杂任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在难题上投入更多精力、持续而不半途而废
copy.tagline_en: Switch your assistant into a high-intensity mode to push through complex tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant to invest more effort and keep going on tough tasks

howto.what: 开启后 Claude 进入 ultrawork 模式：回复首行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!，随后作为编码 agent 干活——先建目标并开一个记事本，用真实渠道（curl、浏览器等）捕获 RED→GREEN 证据，并用待办清单跟踪步骤。
howto.when: 当你在对话里请求 ultrawork 模式、而该指令尚未出现在会话中时触发；它会接管本次回复，第一行固定输出 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!。

howto.what_en: Enables ultrawork mode: Claude's first visible line is exactly ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!, then it works as a coding agent — registering a goal, keeping a notepad, and capturing RED→GREEN plus real-surface evidence.
howto.when_en: Reads only when ultrawork mode is requested in the conversation and the directive is not already present; it then takes over the reply, whose first line is ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!.
